posts.name: Chaosmancer
posts.cooked:
Well, that makes it kind of awkward, to be the first one with comments...

 

I've gotta say, the "47 different things" he wanted to make just stabbed me thru the heart. I saw it coming, but oof, that was emotional.

 

And I love the Wager Master roommate bit, and especially how that explains them being primary nemesises so perfectly. It is the exact kind of ridiculousness that works for those two characters.

 

But, in the end, I don't know if there was a lot of new information. I mean, we got the exact stories to a degree, but there wasn't a lot of stuff beyond that. I don't know, it just wasn't what I expected for some reason.

posts.cooked:
Christopher:

A: “Can a shark ever truly be tamed?”

C: “That is the question. Sharks, by nature-“

A: “Sharks are much like horses-“

C: “Phtbwpwh-p- (strong p in the end, as if you were creating a beat in beatboxing)

A: “Can they ever be tamed?”

C: “-what?”

A: “You can’t tame a shark.”

You can lead shark to water, but you can’t make…

Wait…

You can throw a shark in water, but it will have to keep swimming for the rest of its life or it’ll die. 

Just like a horse.

Case closed.
